apps.name: App-Analyser
apps.summary: A modern Android privacy and security auditing tool that inspects installed packages, surfaces comprehensive diagnostic metadata, and identifies developer country of origin.
apps.description: App-Analyser utilizes an optimized two-phase scanning architecture to inspect permissions, cryptographic certificate fingerprints, and component hierarchies without Binder buffer limits. It highlights developer jurisdiction with policy-compliant badging, flags Chinese-origin applications in crimson red, and strictly enforces GoStore installation provenance.
apps.editorial_tagline: Deep package diagnostics and origin intelligence.
apps.changelog: Initial v1.0.0 release: two-phase package scanning, origin detection, and GoStore provenance protection.
